name: Grafana
description: Dashboards for the metrics that already live on the NAS: point Grafana at InfluxDB (or Prometheus, SQL and other sources) and build graphs, alerts and shared views in the browser. The first visit uses the built-in admin account, which you change immediately; dashboards, users and data sources live in a package volume that survives updates. The web UI opens in its own EthOS window on port 3010 and is reachable on the LAN.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.1.0: the administrator login and password can be set in the Package Center install dialog (Installed → Settings later); the values reach the container as GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER/PASSWORD and create the account on the first start. 1.0.0: first release — Grafana OSS 13.3.1 pinned, dashboards and users in a volume that survives updates, web UI on port 3010 (own login), resource caps and rotated logs.
